name: Incident Timeline Summary
summary: Summarize a JSON array of up to 2,000 events with timestamp, source and text fields. Timestamps must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ in UTC. Prints count, time range and source counts, not event text. Maximum 2 MiB. Install: jq.
